import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["invoices"].copy()

    amount = df["amount"]
    tax = df["tax"]
    due_date = df["due_date"]
    customer_ref = df["customer_ref"]

    r1 = amount.isna() | (amount < 0)
    r2 = tax.isna() | (tax < 0)
    r3 = amount.notna() & tax.notna() & (tax > amount * 0.5)
    r4 = due_date.isna()
    r5 = customer_ref.isna() | (customer_ref.astype(str).str.strip() == "")

    rule_defs = [
        (r1, "AMT_BAD"),
        (r2, "TAX_BAD"),
        (r3, "TAX_EXCESS"),
        (r4, "DUE_NULL"),
        (r5, "REF_EMPTY"),
    ]

    def build_codes(idx):
        codes = []
        for mask, code in rule_defs:
            if bool(mask.loc[idx]):
                codes.append(code)
        return "|".join(codes)

    reason_codes = pd.Series(
        [build_codes(idx) for idx in df.index],
        index=df.index,
        dtype="object",
    )

    has_failure = pd.Series(False, index=df.index)
    for mask, _ in rule_defs:
        has_failure = has_failure | mask

    clean = df.loc[~has_failure].copy()
    rejects = df.loc[has_failure].copy()
    rejects["reason_codes"] = reason_codes.loc[has_failure]

    return {
        "invoices_clean": clean,
        "invoices_rejects": rejects,
    }
